layer_reason: The evidence points at kernel launch geometry and instruction shape (16384 tiny programs, 9 small masked loads per program, select/mask instructions attributed to those loads by the simulator), so the change belongs in the Triton kernel/launch, not in IR passes or metadata layers. The autotune removal and public-symbol rename are pure compatibility edits to the same file.
simulator_incremental_judgment: simulator-evidence.json adds a line-level mechanism attribution that the aggregate profiling cannot give: the VSEL/MOVEMASK/MOVEV sequences and the WAIT_FLAG/BAR waits are attributed to the masked tl.load lines (207/209/211) and the tl.where fix-up lines (223/228), which is why the rewrite drops masks in favour of address clamping and enlarges the tiles. It adds no quantitative distinction: the capture is single-core, covers a 33.0us partial window, records application_completed=false, and its own limitations state instruction times overlap with no critical path or speedup claim, so it cannot predict the magnitude of the 8x program-count reduction.
